from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A party involved in the case."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the individual or entity")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Procedural role (e.g., Appellant, Appellee)")

class FeeDetail(BaseModel):
    """A specific court fee entry."""
    level: str | None = Field(description="Trial level (e.g., First Instance, Second Instance)")
    amount: str | None = Field(description="Numeric fee amount as written")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="Who bears the fee")

class CaseReference(BaseModel):
    """Reference to a court case."""
    number: str | None = Field(description="The official case number string")
    court: str | None = Field(description="Court name associated with the case")

class Document(BaseModel):
    """Extracted facts from a single judgment document."""
    dispute_category: str | None = Field(description="Type of dispute (e.g., Civil, Criminal, Administrative)")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="List of all parties involved")
    fees: list[FeeDetail] = Field(description="All court fee entries found in the document")
    case_numbers: list[CaseReference] = Field(description="Case numbers referenced or cited")
    court_names: list[str] = Field(description="Courts mentioned in the document")
    outcomes: list[str] = Field(description="Key ruling keywords (e.g., 'Dismiss appeal', 'Sustain original')")
    locations: list[str] = Field(description="Addresses or regions mentioned")
    source_id: str | None = Field(description="Identifier for the source document if available")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[Document]
